battery.lowBody: Switch to essentials: your next ticket, hotel address and emergency card on a plain black screen.

battery.turnOffHint: Goes back to the normal app

map.a11yMap: Map of your bookings and nearby places
map.online: Map needs a connection in this test build. It uses the phone’s own map, which loads online. The offline map comes in a later build.
map.noMapTitle: The map can’t load in this build

map.sample: Sample points for the demo trip, not real places. Don’t navigate by them.

map.toggleHint: Shows or hides these places on the map

permissions.files.unavailable: Files couldn’t open on this phone. Choose a photo instead.
offline.title: Flight mode: tickets, cards and documents still work

settings.essentialsManualHint: Manually turns essentials mode on or off. Turning it on opens essentials.

settings.privacyAccounts: No account, no ads, no analytics and no tracking.

settings.emergencyRef: Emergency numbers come with the app (list dated {date}) and work offline. Always verify them locally.
